min_length.description: Minimum length of the passphrase to generate or try.

max_length.description: Maximum length of the passphrase to generate or try.

mode.description: Guessing mode: incremental, random, or file.

input_file.description: Path to the file containing passphrases to try (used when mode is 'file').

output_file.description: Path to the file where the recovered passphrase will be written.

charsets.description: List of character sets for generation. 'a' for a-z, 'A' for A-Z, '0' for 0-9, '.' for ASCII 32-126, '+' for ASCII 32-255.

key_filter.description: Filter string to select a specific GPG key ID or fingerprint.
